messages:
maria: Hey infra team — onboarding new tenant 'Nimbus' in ap-northeast-4. They need accelerated instances for an internal ML pilot. Can we get p5 and g5 entitlements raised and an ENI/IP plan reviewed?

kevin: What's the target capacity? how many instances and what's the timeline? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: Short term pilot: 4 x p5 + 8 x g5 initially, ramp to ~12 p5 / 24 g5 over 6 weeks if perf checks out. Need service by 05/14-ish. This is for customer-facing inference (low latency).

alex: tagging networking — ap-northeast-4 subnets are small in our seed account. We need ENI ceilings increased + NAT capacity. Will break down IP plan in a sec.

raj: Quick heads up: new accounts in ap-northeast-4 sometimes hit ENI per-subnet limits. We should request both Accelerator quota (p5/g5) and "ENIs per subnet" bump and Elastic IP pool increase.

maria: Agreed. Drafting AWS support case now. Adding justification (production pilot, SLA target: 99.9 latency SLO).

cloudops-bot: Cost estimate uploaded to the ticket — expected committed monthly spend if reserved capacity: ~$85k/month for target ramp. Link: https://redwood.internal/costs/nimbus-onboard

kevin: Please include fallback model plan (smaller instances) and automatic routing policy in the ticket so enterprise ops has a rollback path.

maria: Adding that. Fallbacks: 8 x g5 -> 16 x g4dn (cheaper) + auto-route by price/latency. Include canary deployment window.

maria: IP plan (vpc/subnet) — sharing below:
```
VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d (10.40.0.0/16)
Private subnets (apne4-a/b/c): 10.40.1.0/24, 10.40.2.0/24, 10.40.3.0/24
Reserved for GPUs: 10.40.10.0/27 (32 IPs) per AZ initially -> need ENI bump to allow attaching ~40 ENIs across AZs
NAT GW throughput: currently single NAT per AZ, may need scaling to 2 per AZ during deploy
CIDR note: no IPv6 for this VPC (customer requirement)
```

raj: That /27 per AZ is tight. Requesting ENI-per-AZ from 50 -> 120 and subnet IP quota bump. Also request Elastic IP limit from 10 -> 30 for floating NAT IPs.

maria: Filed AWS case: case-id 1234567891. Submitted quotas: p5 (desired 12), g5 (desired 24), ENI-per-subnet bump, Elastic IPs, EC2-VPC quotas. Included cost & justification.

aws-support: aws-support: Case 1234567891 created. Assigned to L2 quota team. Preliminary ETA 72 hours for quota review. Please add exact instance types (p5.24xlarge / g5.48xlarge) and account IDs if not included.

alex: Account ID for Nimbus pilot: 987654321012. I've added the instance types to the case.

kevin: Approving the spend for the pilot. @sre-lead please shepherd the rollout tests and ensure we have spike protection on autoscaling.

sre-lead: Will do. Plan to run capacity smoke test in a staging VPC (mirror of prod) and verify KV cache warmup. We'll throttle rolling builds to avoid saturating local region AZs.

maria: AWS replied — they need subnet ARN and confirmation that ENIs will be used by EC2. Also asked for per-AZ breakdown. I pushed the details.

aws-support: aws-support: Case 1234567891 — quota request updated. L2 asking if we can accept partial increases (e.g., grant 8 p5 + 12 g5 now) to expedite. If yes, reply with allowed partial numbers.

maria: We can accept partial: please provision 8 p5 + 12 g5 immediately, remainder in second wave. Request NAT and ENI bumps in same change window.

raj: I'll prepare a short runbook for the deploy and an IP exhaustion alert in Datadog. Also adding a guardrail: autoscaler cap to avoid bursting above reserved.

kevin: Also add a cost alert for sustained >$70k/month burn.

maria: Thanks all — I'll update case and ping here when AWS confirms. :pray:

cloudops-bot: Automation: on quota grant, run: `./infra/aws-onboard.sh --account 987654321012 --region ap-northeast-4 --alloc p5=8,g5=12 --reserve-subnet 10.40.10.0/27`

maria: AWS updated the case at 3129998930: "Partial grant issued: 8 p5, 12 g5; ENI per-subnet increased to 110; Elastic IPs bumped to 25. Remaining quota for p5/g5 under review." Copy pasted response into ticket.

kevin: Nice. Please schedule staging smoke test for tomorrow morning and don't hit production AZ capacity during office hours.

maria: Scheduling now. Closing loop once staging passes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
